title: In the Mountains
description: At the adventurer camp, Iris informs you that there seems to be some bizarrely hard ice blocking the paths into the mountain...

mainQuestExcel.description: At the adventurer camp, Iris informs you that there seems to be some bizarrely hard ice blocking the paths into the mountain...

dialogs.text: How are things here on Dragonspine?
On this mountain? Well, I can only say that it's more dangerous than any other place in Mondstadt.
Apart from the harsh conditions, this mountain is also home to some strange... ice.
It is incredibly hard to break, and will not melt when exposed to fire.
Worst of all, a few roads have been blocked by this ice.
Quite a few of our expedition teams have been forced to turn back after being blocked by ice barricades that they could not get around.
*sigh* I wonder when we're going to find a way to get rid of that ice...
I'll have a look at it.
You're just going to have a look, right? If so, I remember that there was a large slab of ice of that kind on the mountain's outer boundaries. Who knows what's frozen inside it...
You could have a look around there, but remember, it's best not to come this way again.
This is a sticky situation, indeed...
How are things here on Dragonspine?
On this mountain? Well, I can only say that it's more dangerous than any other place in Mondstadt.
Apart from the harsh conditions, this mountain is also home to some strange... ice.
This ice is incredibly hard to break, and will not melt when exposed to fire. It has proved a major obstacle to our exploration as a result.
Unfortunately, we have been unable to find a way to deal with that ice, so we've had to go around it...
I'll have a look at it.
You're just going to have a look, right? If so, I remember that there was a large slab of ice of that kind on the mountain's outer boundaries. Who knows what's frozen inside it...
You could have a look around there, but remember, it's best not to come this way again.
So, tell me about the ice.
If you'd just like to have a look at the ice, you can just go to the place that I mentioned. For you own safety, don't go any further into the mountain.
Eek! That thing just flew up into the air... Looked like it was going towards the mountain's summit.
Shall we go and have a look around? Or should we go back and ask someone about the situation?
This mountain really is a dangerous place...
Oh? You're back. How did it go? Did you see the ice— Huh. You're in... quite a state, aren't you?
Do you know anything about the air current in the cavern?
You've already been that high up? That's very impressive. Still... a cavern blocked by a strange air current, you say? Let me think...
Ah, that reminds me. We did have an adventure team that also got lucky enough to reach a point very high up the mountain.
They couldn't get close enough, but they did report that a cavern near the summit had a strange and powerful air current flowing out from it.
But logically speaking, no air current in such a place should be that strong. No one knows the reason why, either...
Apart from that strange air current, this mountain is also home to some very strange ice.
This ice is incredibly hard to break, and will not melt when exposed to fire. It has proved a major obstacle to our exploration as a result.
We have been unable to find a way to deal with that ice, so we've had to go around it...
What's more, blue plants are often found growing near this ice.
I could vaguely see that there was something encased within the ice. But since I was unable to melt it, catching a glimpse of it was as far as I got...
If you're interested, you can follow the trail of blue plants to have a look at that ice.
Let me think... I believe that the <color=#00E1FFFF>Entombed City Outskirts</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>Starglow Cavern</color> are home to many of those blue plants. You can go and check them out.
A strange, powerful air current, bizarre ice, and odd plants...
Hahaha, if this was your standard tale of adventure, there would be some link between these three.
But in real life, it's best to be practical when adventuring... Make sure you prepare yourself sufficiently before heading up Dragonspine, you hear?
So, tell me about the ice.
Perhaps you've already noticed, but that slab of ice is surrounded by a great many blue plants.
I believe that those plants may be related in some way to the shard frozen in the ice.
If you wish to continue looking for those shards on Dragonspine, I'd say that you might have some luck following the trail of those blue plants.

dialogs.text: So, tell me about the ice.
Since we've got a way to melt that ice now, that means I can continue organizing expedition parties to explore the mountain...
Huh? The icy surface under the pillar has completely shattered. Looks like there's a huge space underneath it, too. Let's go check it out.
About the summit...
There's a strange, huge pillar floating in mid-air at the summit? To think that there would be such a thing atop Dragonspine...
And there's a huge space below the ice under the pillar? That's... even weirder.
This is... inconceivable. Thank you. I will send explorers up there as quickly as we can to see what's happening there.
Ah, yes, I should thank you for helping us open the way to the summit. Please take these as thanks.
It seems Dragonspine really does have its secrets after all.
I do hope our next expedition will yield some new discoveries.
